reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and I completely understand the request — a lot of our users have asked for the same thing!

Dark mode isn't available in Loopwise just yet, but it's on our radar as a frequently requested feature. I don't have a specific release date to share right now, but I've added your voice to the request so our product team can factor it into prioritization.

In the meantime, if you're using a browser extension or OS-level dark mode setting, some users have found that helps reduce eye strain when using Loopwise, though it won't be a perfect match for the interface.

I'll make sure to follow up with you if this ships or if we have more details to share. Thanks again for the feedback — it genuinely helps us shape the roadmap!

Best,
Loopwise Support
